'''''Jendirian Valley''''' was an [[AA-9 Freighter-Liner]] in service during the [[Separatist Crisis]]. After a failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|plot]] to [[assassin]]ate [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]], she and her [[Jedi]] escort secretly traveled back to her [[homeworld]] aboard the ''Jendirian Valley''.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Refugefamily.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Refugees in the ''Jendirian Valley'']]
The ''Jendirian Valley'' was an [[AA-9 Freighter-Liner]] manufactured by [[Botajef Shipyards]] that could reach speeds of 420 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]] and was 390 [[meter]]s in length. As a [[refugee]] [[transport]], it had a passenger capacity of 30,000 and had over three [[Standard month|months]]' worth of emergency consumables on board. It was equipped with a Class 4 [[hyperdrive]], three powerful [[engine]]s, a starboard and port boarding area, multi-deck accommodation,<ref name="Starfighters" /> several cafeterias, and various [[service droid]]s.<ref name="AA-9 Coruscant freighter" />

==History==
The ''Jendirian Valley'' was utilized as a refugee transport during the [[Separatist Crisis]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars]]. After a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|plot]] to [[assassin]]ate [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo]] failed, the [[Jedi High Council]] thought it better that she be sent back to her [[homeworld]] using unregistered transport and protected by a [[Jedi]] escort.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref>

[[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was dispatched to track down her assassin, while [[Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[R2-D2]] were sent with Amidala. Amidala, Skywalker, and R2-D2 boarded the ''Jendirian Valley'' in<ref name="Episode II" /> the [[western spaceport]] of [[Port District (Coruscant)|Port District]]<ref name="Coruscant">{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}}</ref> on [[Coruscant]]. They eventually reached Naboo.<ref name="Episode II" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Jendirian Valley'' first appeared in the [[2002]] episodic film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Episode II" /> It was later identified in the [[canon]] [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''.<ref name="Starfighters" />
